archetypes.name: dyn-bg-wait-hooks
archetypes.rationale: Step 8 adds new hook marker/probe semantics that interact with multi-live waits and notification recovery.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the changed bg-wait hook logic and Step 8 marker lifecycle. Check that the rc probe is only allowed for live implement-step8-ship markers, that stale counters and sidecars clear on relaunch, and that Monitor/TaskOutput remain denied for all active waits. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
